metadata.case_name: CHAN CHUNG FUN v. TAM LUNG PAU AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.education_level: Completed schooling at F5; two-year telecommunications course; one year book-keeping up to intermediate certificate; certificate in insurance practice

injuries.description: fracture dislocation of the neck at the level of C6-7 with complete transection of the spinal cord at that level
source: he sustained a fracture dislocation of his spine at the level of the 6th and 7th cervical vertebrae.

Mr Chan, as a result of the car accident, has sustained a fracture dislocation of the neck at the level of C6-7 with complete transection of the spinal cord at that level causing paralysis and sensory changes in all four limbs and there is complete involvement of the lower extremities.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of cervical spinal cord

manifestations.description: complete loss of motor function below the level of C6
sensory function was intact above level of C4; from C4 to T3 levels there was paresthesia but complete loss below T4 level
extensive wasting of muscles of the arm, forearm and hands
very weak grip in both hands
spasticity in both lower limbs and no voluntary movement possible
pressure sore (developed and healed on conservative treatment)
cannot sit up without help; cannot get out of bed without being carried; cannot dress himself; cannot wash himself; cannot brush his own teeth or pick his teeth after eating
difficulty feeding himself because of weakness in hands (uses specially adapted spoon)
sexual intercourse is impossible for him

treatments_received: transfer to Margaret Trench Rehabitation Centre
admitted to St. Paul's Hospital for further tests

losses.description: 100% permanent disability; paralysis and sensory changes in all four limbs; wheelchair-bound and incontinent; extensive weakness and wasting of hands
Cannot sit up without help; cannot get out of bed without being carried; cannot dress or wash himself; needs constant attention and attendant

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Cannot perform personal care tasks such as dressing, washing, brushing teeth, feeding without assistance
Will not be able to enjoy or participate with his young son in many activities; much of the pleasure of fatherhood is denied

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Previously enjoyed travelling, swimming, playing football and mahjong; all now impossible

comparable_cases.injury_description: Categories of disablement set out; a starting point for awards for pain, suffering and loss of amenities in the disaster category has been suggested at $150,000
